# Files theme-sync fills with Dracula PRO colors.
# A template names colors in double braces; `theme-sync --names` lists them.
#
#   template in this repository -> generated file
# The whole file, from the free Dracula theme's colors when there is no theme
# package.
herdr/.config/herdr/config.base.toml -> ~/.config/herdr/config.toml
pi/.pi/agent/themes/dracula-pro.json.template -> ~/.pi/agent/themes/dracula-pro.json
#
#   template in this repository >> local override
# A block in the local override, over the tracked config's free Dracula theme;
# the override's other lines stay. Only with a theme package.
tmux/.config/tmux/dracula-pro.conf.template >> ~/.config/tmux/tmux.local.conf
fish/.config/fish/tide-dracula-pro.fish.template >> ~/.config/fish/config-local.fish
